scope: main.go now read in full across v1 and v4: lines 1-554,555-660,661-774,775-898,899-1162. Static review only.

findings.detail: run rejects empty initial allConfigs only. Zero protocol candidates or zero successful live tests still clean existing outputs, write empty/header-only results and return nil if the main/split writes report success. This contradicts the run comment that producing nothing is a failure.

writeMainConfigFile and writeSubFile return errors from buffered WriteString but discard deferred Flush and Close errors; short content may report success despite its final write failing. Country files, summary and streaming writes also ignore write/flush errors.

cleanExistingFiles deletes old output before writing replacements. Failure can lose previous usable output and leave a mixed generation. Cleanup only visits Sub0 through Sub19, while splitting supports arbitrarily many files and writes Sub20 and higher.

originalCount minus candidates includes invalid protocols and unreachable ports, not only duplicates. Summary originalTotal minus live-passing total also includes all test failures. Both label the reduction as duplicate removal.

Input fetches use independent Background contexts, filter TCP checks have no caller context and GeoIP download uses http.Get without explicit timeout. Signal context is not a pipeline-wide cancellation boundary.

Local input uses ReadFile and remote subscription bodies use unbounded ReadAll. Worker count limits simultaneous requests, not total input bytes, decoded size, retained candidate count or elapsed GeoIP download time.

working-live.txt is truncated at each nonempty live test. fmt.Fprintln errors are ignored and no fsync is performed. A positive delay controls streaming while final filtering accepts delay zero as well, refining v2 latency-zero finding: zero-ms successes remain in final output but not the live checkpoint.

The aggregation filter includes SSR, TUIC and warp, but ConvertLink supports none of them. ConvertLink accepts hysteria2:// but the aggregation protocol list only recognizes hy2://. Acceptance stages have inconsistent protocol sets.
splitIntoFiles reverses configs with comment newest first, but order comes from concurrent filtering completion and then retained TestAll input order. It does not establish configuration age.
